reviews.text: A rating we wholeheartedly agree with. All the staff are lovely, compassionate, and professional. We dealt with them during the most difficult times, and each person was reassuring, understanding, and transparent. We entrusted our pet to them with complete peace of mind, not only during the most challenging moments, but also during the best times.

The facilities and staff are very pleasant.

However, their skills are very inadequate when it comes to rabbits. (I don't have any other pets, but they're surely very good with other animals...)
A lovely little clinic, very clean. Dr. Brunet is truly very kind and attentive; I highly recommend him.

I just called for some information about my cat and his changes in habits. The vet on the phone took her time to calmly explain everything and give me advice. I appreciate her professionalism.

I recommend her.
Great! Thanks
Three good

Following my visit today for information about a kitten, I was greeted by Carole, a veterinary assistant. She answered all my questions and guided me towards the right choices. Thank you to her for her kindness and professionalism.
Marvelle and her mother thank you for the years of care and love you gave her. A wonderful team. Thank you so much.
I came to inquire about cat food and I received a very warm welcome and helpful advice from Océane, who is very friendly and professional! Thank you to her!
Océane is great at her job, always smiling, and always available.
Excellent follow-up from Dr. Mathieu, who is very patient and always pleasant with her clients and animals. The reception is always welcoming, and booking an appointment is quick and easy!

Top-notch veterinary clinic:
The doctors and assistants are qualified and caring.
We feel confident in the care of our young cat and puppy; they also provide excellent advice.

This clinic was able to perform a specific examination for my cat, an examination that wasn't even possible at a veterinary hospital. (Before finding this clinic, I thought I'd have to go to Nice.)
The staff is attentive. The veterinarian called me back with the results. I'm satisfied with the care I received.

The clinic is clean, and the table is cleaned between animals, which isn't always the case.
I called today for advice on vaccinations, and the receptionist gave me excellent information. Having consulted four vets in Marseille, this clinic's staff is the one I trust the most. It's a shame the location is so far away for me.

This was my dog's clinic. They were always on time, the prices were normal like everywhere else, and they were super professional and competent. No matter which veterinarian I consulted, they always gave good advice and showed empathy!
It's clean, and the receptionists were very kind.
I lost my dog ​​on July 22nd, and they showed great respect and kindness.
You can really go there with your eyes closed, and thank you.
I brought my dog ​​Djebel in for an eye emergency. From the reception to the treatment, everything was perfect ❤️❤️❤️ Excellent clinic in my opinion 💯💯💯 …

A huge thank you to the entire team at ValentineVet Clinic!

We wanted to express our sincere gratitude for your warm welcome, kindness, and compassion.
The veterinary assistants always greet us with a smile, a kind word, and a gentle touch. And when we need help, they are always there to listen and do their utmost to support us.

We also wish to extend our heartfelt thanks to Dr. Brunet for his patience, availability, and the time he takes to clearly explain each step of Fonsy's care. At a time when we thought we might lose him, his support and humanity deeply touched us.

We know Fonsy is old and frail, but thanks to you, we feel much more at ease with him.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for everything you do for him and for us.

Mrs. Magliano and her friend.

My two dogs have been under the care of Dr. Gallucci for over a year. She is gentle, attentive, and competent. I trust her completely with my animals' care.

The clinic is modern and very well-equipped: standard checkups, biochemical analysis, surgery, etc.
The team is very welcoming, and there's parking, which is very convenient. The experience is handled with the utmost care from start to finish. I highly recommend her.

I took Roxy to the vet for an emergency dental surgery. The vet and assistants were very responsive and were able to operate the very next day. Everything was clear and clean, and Roxy already seems to be feeling better. Follow-up care is also planned, which is much appreciated. The clinic is very clean.

Thank you for your kindness and understanding despite my stress 😅

ValentineVet Clinic has become our go-to vet after several bad experiences with other practitioners. Dr. Fraisse managed to get our French bulldog, Looping, to accept appointments; she's the only one who's succeeded by giving him a lick stick and a towel around his neck.
A very good veterinary clinic; we recommend it without hesitation. They are attentive and responsive.
Thank you for your professionalism.

This isn't the clinic where my dogs are regularly seen, but I've had the opportunity to go there once or twice and I was very satisfied. From the reception to the consultations with the veterinarians, they were very kind and professional!

They are wonderful with our babies as well as with us; they are fantastic in every sense of the word. Smiling, reassuring, and they love animals, which is so important and the opposite of what I've seen in other clinics where money is more important than anything else. So, kudos to the whole team for caring so much about our babies and us. THANK YOU ALL ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ ❤️

A welcoming and very clean clinic.
The assistants are friendly and the veterinary care is excellent.
You can tell that the well-being of our animals is important to them, and they are examined with gentleness and care.

I discovered this clinic by chance on a public holiday, and since then, it has become my dog's veterinary clinic. I recommend it 1000%! The entire team is wonderful, caring, and passionate. Thank you for your professionalism and kindness.

We've entrusted Scott to this clinic since he was 6 months old, and we're still just as happy with them.

The whole team is attentive, caring, and very professional. You can tell they genuinely love animals and take the time to reassure both owners and their pets.

They're always available when needed, with kindness and care.
Thank you for everything you've done for Scott all these years 🐶
Very welcoming. Very professional yet gentle with our furry friends.

I am very satisfied with the Valentinevet clinic, both the veterinarians and their assistants.
The clinic is very clean, the reception is perfect, and the care is efficient.
My animals have been treated there for years, and I wouldn't change.
I highly recommend them for their professionalism, the competence of the veterinarians and assistants, the care provided, their kindness, and their immense compassion.
A veterinarian who listens and provides preventative advice.

I went to Valentine Vet on a Saturday for an emergency: my cat had swallowed a string with a pendant attached. He was treated with great care and professionalism. The clinic is modern and seems very well-equipped. I'm going back this week to have him neutered.
Excellent, I recommend 100%! The team is caring and always friendly, and Dr. Brunet is very competent and gentle. I have complete confidence in him. Thank you for following Polka (Guiral).

The consultation went very well overall: my cat received excellent care, the vet was attentive, and the time spent on the appointment was commendable.

However, one thing made me uncomfortable: a dandruff treatment product was applied directly to my cat after being opened, and then charged for, without my prior consent.
I felt it was a forced sale, especially since the consultation already included the vaccination. In my opinion, it would have been preferable to explain the product to me and ask for my opinion before applying it.
Aside from this issue, the experience remained positive.

Even though today, and for a long time to come, we must learn to live without Mitzy, or rather Bibinou, I thank the veterinary team for their kindness and humanity. They supported us, listened to us... Thank you all!

My dog ​​is seen by Dr. Galucci, who recently performed surgery on him. I particularly appreciated her professionalism; she is very conscientious, caring, and gentle with the animal. She takes the time to explain things and is a great listener. Furthermore, the whole team is friendly, which makes the vet visit very pleasant. Thank you!

P.S.: The clinic is very clean, which is also a plus!
A fantastic team, incredibly kind and caring, and top-notch service at very reasonable prices. Thank you 🙏 …

Dr. Brunet is very competent and incredibly kind. He has been taking care of our animals for years. Always with kindness, empathy, and compassion, I highly recommend him to anyone who loves their pets.
The staff were excellent, very kind and very professional.

Thieves!

I am extremely disappointed and angry after my visit to this veterinary clinic.

I was charged €15.30 for 8 cat hydration sachets, and on top of that, an extra sachet was added to the bill. The problem is that this product costs around €8.50 on ChronoVet. So we're talking about almost double the price. It's even more shocking that the sachets were sold individually from an already opened carton.

I also noticed on several occasions that the dog and cat food offered for sale was expired. I reported it several times, but the situation seems to be repeating itself, which is unacceptable when it comes to the health of our animals.

I really feel that transparency and respect for the customer are lacking. When you go to a veterinary clinic, you expect honest advice and fair prices, not these kinds of unpleasant surprises.

I absolutely do not recommend this establishment.
👍👍👍 The best, CLINIC, hats off to the staff and DOCTOR …

The team at the ValentineVet veterinary clinic, and especially Dr. Brunet, take wonderful care of my dog ​​and cat.

Although we no longer live in Marseille, we have remained loyal to this veterinary clinic, which perfectly meets all our expectations.
Excellent veterinary clinic! I've been very happy to take my dog ​​there for a year now!

Dr. Gallucci is always so kind and gentle with my rabbit; she does her work with professionalism and heart!

I have complete confidence in her and her team.
Carole at reception is also warm and attentive.
I highly recommend this very clean and well-decorated practice.
Emergency consultation. Very welcoming and a top-notch vet.
Doctors Brunet & Gallucci are simply amazing!!! They are caring, highly competent, kind, and patient with both animals and their owners. I have complete confidence in them.
Very professional and attentive.
I received a very warm welcome. All the veterinarians are exceptionally kind, and their love for animals is evident from the moment you arrive.

We were seen by Dr. Brunet, who unfortunately informed us that our German Shepherd had cancer. I would particularly like to thank Dr. Brunet for his empathy, kindness, and professionalism during this difficult time.
Excellent visit! The team is truly professional, attentive and caring.
Thank you to Dr. Perrine Fraisse for treating our little cat Bella. Dr. Fraisse is very professional, available, and demonstrates a great deal of empathy.

An exceptional center, filled with kindness and compassion. Professionalism is evident in all circumstances from the entire team. A huge thank you to Dr. de Napo and Dr. Gallucci for all the years spent by his side, including accompanying him with dignity until the very end of his life, and for so many other admirable qualities.

A big thank you also to Dr. Brunet, who is equally endowed with all the necessary qualities for such a profession.
Dear Doctors, please take care of yourselves as you would the animals you care for.
A consultation a few months ago followed by a minor procedure today. Always a warm welcome, quick availability, excellent advice, attentive listening… in short, top-notch!
Very friendly staff, spotless premises. I recommend this veterinary clinic without hesitation.

A fantastic welcome! It was my puppy Abby's first time there, and she was treated like a princess! Regarding the prices, I can't compare them to anything else, but they didn't seem too high... In any case, I highly recommend them just for the very friendly and caring staff!

I was very pleased with my visit.
The entire staff is warm and attentive.
Thank you to Dr. Brunet for his professionalism!

Thank you for your feedback.
Please feel free to tell us how we can improve.
Long live Brittany!

Excellent welcome, excellent care, and a superbly equipped clinic. I'm very happy with Dr. Martel, who was already treating my dog ​​before we came to ValentineVet.

I highly recommend them.

Hello Ms. M. Dupont, we are sorry that you were not satisfied.

I am unable to determine which case this feedback concerns.
Please feel free to contact us again to tell us what was unsatisfactory so that this feedback can be constructive.

A caring and professional veterinary clinic that truly cares for your animals. The clinic is very clean, and the veterinary assistants give a warm welcome—a special thank you to Celia and Isabelle ♥️. Sadly, I lost my little girl, and the veterinary team did everything they could until the very end. The prices are very reasonable.

I recommend this clinic wholeheartedly.
A huge thank you to the entire team.
As always, we received a very warm welcome and the vets are top-notch! I highly recommend them!

The ValentineVet veterinary clinic provided us with incredibly compassionate support during the passing of our Labrador.

From the initial phone call to Dr. Fraysse's care, we felt a great deal of empathy and understanding. We wish to express our gratitude to Dr. Fraysse, whose tact, gentleness, and empathy were a great comfort to us. Dr. Fraysse eased our 14-year-old companion's suffering with great tenderness and provided us with invaluable support during this difficult time.

We warmly recommend the ValentineVet clinic, which shows as much consideration for animals as it does for their owners.

Frédérique Bouchard
Competent professionals and quality service, always available and attentive, and accepts emergencies.

I have two dogs and I thank this team of veterinarians for their competence, compassion, and kindness. They never provide excessive care, always offer a suitable solution, and their prices are reasonable with the option of paying in installments.
The veterinary assistants are also very welcoming and pleasant. There's a real sense of humanity at this veterinary practice.

I called them at 6 pm for an emergency with my kitten after calling about ten different vets. They gave me an appointment for 6:30 pm. Nala was seen by Dr. Natacha Mathieu, who was very gentle with her. She was able to refer me to an ophthalmologist for an emergency appointment, and he was able to see Nala the next morning. She explained everything to me: the possible diagnoses, the potential treatments, and she answered all my questions. I highly recommend this clinic for their speed and professionalism. Thank you so much!

A humane and professional veterinary clinic that truly cares for animals. The receptionists and veterinarians listen attentively to our concerns and requests, and explain things clearly. Our cat, Chips, receives excellent care at a reasonable price. Thank you for everything.

A very professional and attentive team.
My dog ​​was seen as an emergency.
For a first visit, my 11-year-old Belgian Malinois was operated on with exceptional skill for a splenic tumor. The tumor weighed nearly 7 kg.

Thank you to the entire team, from the receptionist to the veterinary assistant and the doctors. Thank you so much for my dog.
He is being monitored and remains under observation to prevent any complications.
The price is reasonable.
I highly recommend this clinic.
The staff and veterinarian, especially Dr. Brunet, were fantastic! Thank you for taking such good care of our little Mila! They were attentive and very efficient!

We have been seeing Dr. Brunet at the ValentineVet clinic for many years. The care is always excellent, characterized by great kindness and genuine attention to our six cats at each visit. Dr. Brunet is a good listener, professional, and always takes the time to clearly explain the treatments and available options. We have complete confidence in his expertise and support. The entire clinic team is also welcoming and helpful, making each visit reassuring and pleasant.

Our little Apollo is being treated by Dr. Brunet. He's a fantastic vet; we had our Chihuahua operated on for his milk teeth, and he reassured us completely. Everything went very well, and the veterinary assistants were incredibly kind—everyone took such good care of him. A huge thank you! 🥰 …
